provenance: Author's symbolic model: 10x10 vs 100x100 perception and optional avoidance; 99 equal-rank units can be an alternative, much costlier aggregation goal.

rank_example.warning: Power is an address class and not physical combat strength.

difference_between_goals.s009_promotion: nine newly absorbed ordinary peer-equivalents per generation
difference_between_goals.bulk_aggregation: an equal unit plus 99 others forms a collection of 100 equal-sized units; not the automatic promotion rule

decision_hypotheses.fight: only if perceived threat and available energy justify risk
decision_hypotheses.flight: favored when counterpart is estimated far larger and disengagement feasible
decision_hypotheses.hide: favored if movement is costly or exposure can be reduced
decision_hypotheses.balance: favored if there is no reason to engage
decision_hypotheses.engulfment: never required simply because a target exists
